ctx.x: So the cat...when he come back next month to pay off, the cats say, "You owe us thirty dollars." Say, "No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. I don't owe you no thirty dollars. Owe you twenty-one dollars." Say, "Whaddya mean? I sold you so many half-pints..." "Jus' a minute." He go in the bathroom, and "Shit, look, I mark 'em down." And couldn't get by that. "I mark 'em down...how many half-pints I got."

One time he got drunk...we looked for him for two days. He went in the basement...went down in the basement where they kept the coal at...was down there asleep. So I had to go down in the basement one day and find him down there asleep...set layin' on the floor asleep. So I got him up, took him upstairs, washed his face and everything, got him back straight. He went right back to drinkin'. I never will forget him. He used to be a good, little white fellow. He come by a-a-a-a-a-l-lll... every month. He didn't miss…
